digest.component_or_area: code-review gate criteria routing and blocking posture
propositions: correctness and edge-cases criteria lack routing entries and resolve through the unknown-criterion default (0.95 threshold, non-blocking), despite being the 3rd and 4th largest un-routed dimensions (909 and 618 findings) in the code-v3 corpus

measured block-impact at 0.54 threshold for correctness and edge-cases shows 4.04% and 1.74% of changes would block respectively, both within the 8.0% operator-accepted friction budget recorded for tests criterion
concurrency criterion is routed but advisory (0.95 threshold, non-blocking); at 0.54 it would block zero changes (n=1 below calibration floor), so it holds advisory

correctness and edge-cases must be added to criteria_routing.json as blocking entries at 0.54 threshold, shaped as base-reviewer dimensions (exec and applies_to fields inert); concurrency re-tune in overlay.json does not clobber the packaged posture
replay_code_v4_would_block.py hard-codes its blocking set and must derive it from registry.routing_index() filtered on blocking_enabled to prevent posture drift
new unit test corpus-free validates routing/document agreement, numeric budget bound, vocabulary widening, overlay non-clobber, and routing-derived replay blocking set
